template: 16-bit pixel art video game sprite of one small original character: a courier whose head is an oversized round bright golden brass oil lamp with a glowing warm yellow glass lens and a small spout on top, wearing a long dark navy coat, thin dark legs and a small brown leather satchel on the hip. {pose}. Full body, one single character centered, plain flat white background, crisp hard-edged square pixels, flat 2D colours, limited palette of warm yellow, cream, navy, brown and near-black, 1-pixel dark outline, no 3D rendering, no shading, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no text, no letters, no watermark

poses.name: turn_front
poses.text: Front view, standing straight and facing the viewer, arms at the sides

poses.name: idle
poses.text: Side view facing right, standing relaxed, arms hanging at the sides

poses.name: walk_contact
poses.text: Side view facing right, walking mid-stride, front leg forward and back leg behind, legs wide apart

poses.name: walk_passing
poses.text: Side view facing right, walking, one knee raised, legs passing each other

poses.name: cast
poses.text: Side view facing right, one arm stretched straight forward, pointing and casting light

poses.name: hurt
poses.text: Side view facing right, recoiling backwards in pain, leaning back, one leg lifted

poses.name: levelup
poses.text: Side view facing right, cheering with both arms raised high above the head

poses.name: sunflare
poses.text: Side view facing right, arms spread wide to both sides, the lamp head blazing with bright rays of light

poses.name: defeat
poses.text: Collapsed, lying flat on the ground on its side, the lamp head dark and unlit

poses.name: victory
poses.text: Side view facing right, triumphant, one fist punched high into the air, feet planted wide
